title: area_trigger
summary: Benilla's whole job here is: detect the player walking into an AreaTrigger.dbc volume (exit-latch, first containing row wins, latch cleared on map change) and send CMSG_AREATRIGGER so the SERVER decides what it means. MSUI parses AreaTrigger.dbc, implements the same exit-latch containment check (portal fires once per entry, latch re-seeds on spawn so a return portal does not re-fire), but resolves the destination LOCALLY via a bundled areatrigger_teleport table and teleports itself - it never tells the server.

openItems.text: CMSG_AREATRIGGER is never sent (no reference anywhere in Net/): when connected, walking into a trigger volume fires nothing server-side - online dungeon/portal teleports, quest explore objectives (areatrigger_involvedrelation), inn rested-state triggers and battleground entrances all silently do not happen.
Non-teleport triggers are explicitly ignored (only rows with a local teleport destination fire), whereas the reference reports every entered volume and lets the server decide.
